summary: Lead review of the final head: producer-ID retries reuse the first receive clock stored with the row (server.ts admitHookBody, buffer.ts first_received_at); ID-less spooled hooks get a deterministic fallback id from the spool file, so a crash between commit and unlink replays to the same row; every future-skew check uses the durable receive instant. Four rounds of Codex findings closed with red/green proofs; CI proof green on ef01bcbf; Codex review of this head clean.
